therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with mild to moderate Alzheimer's disease
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: safety and tolerability (AEs/SAEs), MRI abnormalities, PK/PD (amyloid load by PET, CSF/plasma concentrations)

results.effect_size: Change in amyloid load (PIB SUVR) at Month 13 in Cohort M: PF-04360365 arm ranged from -0.009 to -0.103 across brain regions vs placebo -0.013 to -0.113; no statistically significant difference
results.target_engagement_evidence: Marked elevation of plasma A-beta 1-x and A-beta 1-40 in treated arms (>80,000–150,000 pg/mL) vs placebo (~200–1500 pg/mL), consistent with peripheral sequestration of amyloid beta by antibody; CSF PF-04360365 detectable (60–325 ng/mL) confirming CNS penetration
biomarker_changes: Plasma A-beta 1-x markedly elevated in both treatment cohorts vs placebo throughout dosing period
Plasma A-beta 1-40 markedly elevated in both treatment cohorts vs placebo throughout dosing period
CSF A-beta changes were small and inconsistent across timepoints and cohorts
CSF tau and p-tau changes were small and not clearly differentiated from placebo
No anti-drug antibodies detected in any treated participant
PIB PET amyloid SUVR changes at Month 13 were numerically similar between PF-04360365 and placebo across all brain regions
subgroup_findings: ADAS-cog LS mean difference at Month 18 Cohort Q: 8.18 (90% CI 1.24–15.12), p=0.0534, numerically favoring placebo
MMSE change at Month 13: LS mean difference 1.35 (Cohort Q) and 1.45 (Cohort M), both non-significant
DAD changes at Month 13 and 18 not significantly different between arms
safety_signals: Overall AE rates: 9/12 (75%) PF-04360365 Cohort Q, 5/6 (83%) placebo Cohort Q, 10/12 (83%) PF-04360365 Cohort M, 5/6 (83%) placebo Cohort M
SAEs: 2/12 PF-04360365 Cohort Q, 1/6 placebo Cohort Q, 1/12 PF-04360365 Cohort M, 0/6 placebo Cohort M
Micro hemorrhage on MRI: 1 participant each in PF-04360365 Cohort Q, PF-04360365 Cohort M, and placebo Cohort M
No gadolinium use required in any participant

dose_info.dose: 10 mg/kg (Cohort Q); 10 mg/kg loading then 7.5 mg/kg maintenance (Cohort M)
dose_info.schedule: Every 90 days x5 doses (Cohort Q); 10 mg/kg loading dose then 7.5 mg/kg monthly x12 maintenance doses (Cohort M)

context.duration: Up to 18 months (treatment up to ~13 months, follow-up to 18 months)

results_by_chain.population_description: patients with mild to moderate Alzheimer's disease receiving 10 mg/kg every 90 days

results_by_chain.endpoint: Amyloid load by PIB PET at Month 13
